references.text: Dan was born as the son of Jacob (Israel) through Bilhah, Rachel's maidservant. This explains the expression 'Dan their ancestor, who was born in Israel'.
Dan is mentioned as a place already in Abraham's time, which may be an anachronism or an editorial update of the place's name.
Parallel account of how the tribe of Dan conquered Laish (Lajish) and gave the city the name Dan after their ancestor.
Earlier in the chapter, Lajish is described as a peaceful city, which explains why the Danites chose to attack it.
Dan later became known as the place where Jeroboam set up one of the golden calves, leading Israel into sin.
Jacob's blessing over Dan, describing the tribe as one that will judge his people.
